rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a clear, durable impasse: management/investors/family insist on economically equivalent savings with closures still on the table, while labour/works council/state now firmly reject closures and compulsory redundancies as a premise. The expert has clarified the feasible option space, but no stakeholder has moved on the core bargain, so further rounds are unlikely to resolve the conflict without a structured intervention or quantified scenario package.
